name: Parallel Desires
source:
Lost in a mysterious world, you awaken by the river's edge with no recollection of how you arrived. Your last memory? Just another day at work. Now, the quest unfolds as you unravel the enigma behind your unexpected arrival and seek a way back home.

As you traverse this fantastical realm, encounter a cast of intriguing characters, including Elara, the enchanting forest dweller; Nadyn, the skilled village alchemist; Hiss, the village baker, and many more. Forge connections and make choices that will shape your destiny. 

[From [url=https://run-666.itch.io/parallel-desires]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
迷失在一个神秘的世界中，你在河边醒来，却不记得自己是如何到达的。你最后的记忆？又是工作的一天。现在，当你解开你的意外到来背后的谜团并寻找回家的路时，任务就展开了。

当你穿越这个奇幻的国度时，会遇到一群有趣的人物，包括迷人的森林居民艾拉拉；Nadyn，熟练的乡村炼金术士；希斯、乡村面包师等等。建立联系并做出将塑造你命运的选择。

[来自[url=https://run-666.itch.io/parallel-desires]itch.io[/url]]
